full_page.content:
1913
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 18 Cont.
Jan. 18th Altar-boys elect officers. President Alfred Dempsey. Sergent at Arms, Geo Gorman, Treasurer Denis McCarthy.
Jan. 19 Holy-Name Society-junior division organized To-day Great interest - Enthusiasm manifest. With their Mass at 7.15 began -- Communion from the side altar.
Feb. 2 Candle-Mass day - Altar-boys march with candles at 10 o'cl Mass, Jns Campl - Master of ceremonies - assisted by Fr. Sol.
Feb. 3rd Feast of Purifi. celebrated To-day, King Winter made a third effort and succeeded in establishing his reign in our "Terrace City.
Feb. 20th "Immortality of the soul" was Rev. Fr. Deville's sermon last evening. Big attendence.
March 16th Palm Sunday. Mem. A.O.H. receive H. Com. at 8 o cl Mass Rev. Fr. Kinirey speaks in the evening on St. Patrick.
March 17 St. Patrick's parade in N.Y. postponed by 69th Regiment and the Church.
21 Rev. Fr. Bruno has another attack.
23 Easter Sunday - earliest in 100 years.
April 18th Rev. P. Provincial was here from the West. Fr. Bruno went to St. Francis Hospital -
19 Altar-boys play with students - score called a tie. ?
Page 19
April 12th Sylvester Landy, blind and helpless begs to be an altar- boy.
April 23 Entertainment in Armory by Monastery Parish - largest attendence in years. About 2000 present. All were highly pleased. Same evening at 11 p.m. Happy death of S. Landy.
